svg.desc: Three synthetic trials contain five positions each. A thirty-degree coordinate rotation changes components while preserving interval displacement lengths and magnitudes of average velocity. Equal axis scales preserve the geometric comparison; connecting lines do not establish between-sample motion.
svg.title: Trajectories before and after rotation
